name: The Professional
tagline: Hunting monsters is your day job, with an Agency behind you. You get real gear and backup, plus the paperwork and politics that come with it.
luckSpecial: Spending Luck means the Agency's next assignment for you is buried in bureaucracy.

moves.intro: Take every basic move and four Professional moves. Deal With the Agency comes free; choose three others from the list.

auto.name: Deal With the Agency
auto.trig: When you ask the Agency for help or equipment, or try to cover for a failure
auto.full: Approved: you get the gear or people you asked for, or your mistake slips by unnoticed.
auto.part: Mixed result. You may take a scolding and face fallout, but you still receive what the job needs.
auto.miss: You blew it. Expect a suspension, an investigation or just a bad reputation, with no assistance until you straighten things out.

choices.name: Bottle It Up
choices.summary: You can add up to +3 to an act under pressure roll. For each +1 you add, the Keeper banks 1 hold, which can later be cashed in one for one to hit you with -1 on any move other than act under pressure.

choices.name: Battlefield Awareness
choices.summary: You stay aware of everything around you and of the threats to watch for. Gain +1 armour on top of your gear, up to a total of 2-armour.

choices.name: Leave No One Behind
choices.trig: In combat, when you help someone escape
choices.part: Pick one: you get them out, or you take no harm.
choices.miss: They stay trapped and enemies turn on you.

choices.name: Tactical Genius
choices.summary: Reading a bad situation can use +Cool instead of +Sharp.

choices.name: Medic
choices.trig: When you give first aid with your complete kit and training
choices.full: The patient is stable and recovers 2 harm.
choices.part: Either recover 2 harm or get the injury stabilized, not both.
choices.note: This move replaces the regular first aid move.

choices.name: Mobility
choices.summary: You own a monster-hunting vehicle (truck, van or car). Give it two good traits and one bad one. Good traits: (1) roomy, (2) surveillance gear, (3) fast, (4) stealthy, (5) intimidating, (6) classic, (7) medical kit, (8) sleeping space, (9) toolkit, (10) concealed weapons, (11) anonymous, (12) armoured (+1 armour inside), (13) tough, (14) monster cage. Bad traits: (a) loud, (b) obvious, (c) temperamental, (d) beaten-up, (e) gas-guzzler, (f) uncomfortable, (g) slow, (h) old.

gear.title: Protection
gear.intro: Pick either a flak vest or combat armour.

extras.title: Who the Agency is
extras.intro: Decide who you work for. Some ideas are below; make up something else if you prefer.

extras.title: The Agency's goal
extras.intro: Decide what the Agency is trying to achieve. Make up your own if none of these fit.

extras.title: Agency resource tags
extras.intro: Your Agency gets two resource tags.

extras.title: Agency red tape tags
extras.intro: Pick two red tape tags for the Agency.

history: There could be something romantic between you, but it has not gone anywhere yet.
The Agency has them under watch, and you have been observing them.
You are family. Say how closely.
A mission put you together, and you teamed up off the books with good results.
They have done work for the Agency in the past and have a good name there.
You were friends in training before the Agency took you on. It might have been the military, the police or something stranger; sort out the details together.
They rescued you, and maybe your team, from a mission that went disastrously wrong.
The Agency once sent you to handle them because they threatened its policies. Tell them how it ended.
